purpose: Posthoc hard-case probe of equal whitened-channel training weights and three blind held-out gate statistics.

case_selection.selection_source: Retired hierarchical-v1 development results. These six rows are deliberately difficult examples, not an independent evaluation set.

fit_ablation.primary_fit_channel_weights: one for every already-whitened EEG and MEG channel
fit_ablation.other_settings: unchanged from the hierarchical-v2 development runner

notation.Y_m: held-out whitened confirmation data for modality m, shape C_m x T
notation.Yc_m: Y_m after subtracting each channel's baseline mean, shape C_m x T
notation.B: fixed smooth active-window DCT basis, shape K x T; its rows are orthonormal on the active samples and zero elsewhere
notation.R_m: Yc_m B^T, shape C_m x K
notation.X0_X1: training source estimates from the surface-only null and surface-plus-deep full fits, each shape P x T
notation.P0_m_P1_m: G_m (X0 or X1) B^T, each shape C_m x K
notation.v_mi: sample baseline variance of centered whitened channel i: sum_baseline(Yc_m[i,t]^2)/(B0-1)
notation.u: B restricted to active samples, summed over time; a length-K vector

score_definitions.studentized_modality: z_m = d_m / sqrt(V_m), where V_m = 4*sum_i v_mi*[||Delta_m[i,:]||_2^2 + (Delta_m[i,:] dot u)^2/B0]
score_definitions.studentized_channel_weights: No channel_weights enter held-out scoring. Predictions are produced by the equal-weight fit, but R, d, v, N, q, and V are computed in the already-whitened physical channel blocks without multiplying the former training-derived channel weights.
score_definitions.studentized_covariance_approximation: Temporal covariance from subtracting a shared baseline mean is retained through u*u^T/B0. Cross-channel covariance is ignored; each whitened channel uses its own baseline variance v_mi.
score_definitions.studentized_constant_4: The random part of a squared-loss difference is 2 times the noise inner product with Delta. Squaring that coefficient gives the factor 4 in V_m.
score_definitions.zero_delta_rule: If Delta_m and d_m are both zero, z_m is reported as zero rather than dividing by zero.

development_status.equal_weight_fit: Motivated by retired failure analysis; this probe is not independent validation.
development_status.snr_blind_consensus: The formula and its 0.25 exponent were selected using 113 retired-v1 labeled cases, so its apparent performance there is development-polluted.
development_status.energy_normalized_fixed: The square-root normalization was inspected on the same 113 retired-v1 labeled cases and these hard examples. It is a candidate requiring fresh development calibration before validation.
development_status.studentized: A diagnostic candidate inspected on earlier development cases and these hard examples; it fails separation here and is not proposed as the gate.
